public_construction_notes: City CAFR FY2005: "The total construction cost of $250,000 [thousand] is to be funded from $186,000 from Senior Lien Revenue Bonds, $20,000 from Subordinate Lien Revenue Bonds, $12,000 each by the City and the County from non-ad valorem revenues, and $20,000 from the State of Tennessee for a parking structure and intermodal transfer station." Sports Authority bonds ($206M) are repaid from seat fees, state sales-tax rebates on Grizzlies-generated taxes (2001-2031), county car-rental fees, city and county hotel-motel taxes and MLGW in-lieu-of-tax payments (FY2015 CAFR; split not documented -> mixed). City $12M for site and infrastructure, to be repaid from hotel-motel taxes (-> tourist); County $12M (general); State $20M parking structure (general). Total includes site, infrastructure and the parking structure; no team contribution in the funding table. The 2001 MLGW Water PILOT ($2.5M a year through FY2028) was pledged to the senior arena bonds, so it is inside this money; MLGW's board (7-0, Aug 19 2026) and the City Council (Sept 1 2026) extended it to FY2048, "exclusively for the maintenance and/or capital improvements" of FedExForum: $2.5M a year for FY2029-48, $50M nominal, future and not counted (b). Private Chapter 67 (2024) allocates up to $11.4M a year of the county hotel tax, from July 2025, to the county's arena bond debt service and payments under the arena agreements (b; county approval not confirmed): a funding source for money already counted or pending, not added. 2023 Public Chapters 405 and 272 extend the state sales-tax apportionment and the car-rental surcharge for the arena to June 30 2059 (b): future money, not counted.
